home.headline: A Source Available admin framework for study and research
home.subhead: Multi-tenant, permissions, workflow, and codegen—built to ship SaaS and internal systems faster.

ctaBand.title: Read the source, then run it locally
ctaBand.body: Read the full source and architecture docs, then run and debug in an isolated local environment.

lines.title: Three pillars, one delivery path
lines.lead: Unlike kitchen-sink scaffolds, this is a complete, runnable admin and office-process foundation.

foundation.title: Enterprise admin foundation
foundation.body: Multi-tenant, org, RBAC, dictionaries, audit, and security policies—ready to govern.

oa.title: OA & workflow
oa.body: Flowable design plus tenant office configuration for real approval workloads.

codegen.title: Engineering & codegen
codegen.body: Consistent structure and CRUD generation—extend modules by convention, not from scratch.

reuse.title: One foundation, many projects
reuse.body: Separate platform capabilities from business modules—stop rebuilding admin stacks from scratch.

govern.title: Governable out of the box
govern.body: Tenants, orgs, menus, security policies, and audit trails ready for delivery.

license.title: Non-commercial study and research licence
license.body: Source is public for learning and research. Commercial use is prohibited without a separate written licence.

path.title: From discovery to go-live
path.lead: Primary path: read the source, run it locally, study the design. Any commercial use requires a separate written licence.

fit.title: Check fit
fit.body: Confirm multi-tenant, permissions, workflow, and codegen match your admin scenario.

license.title: Read the licence
license.body: Obtain usage rights and agreed documentation/updates, then deploy your environment.

deploy.title: Deploy & extend
deploy.body: Initialize and grow business modules on the foundation—optionally with delivery partners.
